# U86: Day one is true for both: set up a workspace with a teammate, giving him one goal and leaving the rest unowned; Check says how many have no owner; Home says what is left (first check-ins, owners, the link); the teammate is told who set it up and what is his; Hide this removes the block

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `DAY-ONE`, `ONBOARDING`
- **Budget:** at most 24 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U86

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Step.** Open the workspace switcher (the sidebar’s header on a computer, the top bar’s line on a phone).
- **Step.** Press the “Set up a new workspace” button in the Workspaces dialog.
- **Check:** The step counter shows.
- **Step.** Type “Field Operations” into the “Workspace name” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to people” button.
- **Check:** “Who’s on it?” is shown.
- Type “Ben Ortiz” into the “Person 1: name” field.
- Type “ben.ortiz@example.com” into the “Person 1: email” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to goals” button.
- **Check:** “What outcome are you after?” is shown.
- **Check:** “What feeds it?” is shown.
- _Note:_ Set-up has no example goals (ST2): the outcome and three goals feeding it are typed.
- Set-up's goals step, "Add your own": the outcome as [title, today, target, unit] and up to four goals feeding it, each [title, today, target, unit]; the first card is already there (`typeSetupGoals(p, ['Weekly active users', '1200', '2000', 'users'], [['New users activated in week one', '35', '50', '%'], ['Time to first value', '20', '8', 'min'], ['Weekly retention', '55', '65', '%']])`).
- _Note:_ A goal card nobody had touched starts owned by whoever sets up (and can be left with no owner): give Ben the first and leave the other two with no owner.
- Find and pick: press “Owner” in the pick (`.pick`) with the field label (`.field-label`) (number 2), type “ben”, and choose “Ben Ortiz”.
- Find and pick: press “Owner” in the pick (`.pick`) with the field label (`.field-label`) (number 3), and choose “No owner yet”.
- Find and pick: press “Owner” in the pick (`.pick`) with the field label (`.field-label`) (number 4), and choose “No owner yet”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “owners”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to check” button.
- **Check:** “{worked out in the journey as `left === 1 ? '1 goal has' : '${left} goals have'`} no owner yet. You can choose them now, or from Home afterwards.” is shown (else: Check does not say how many goals have no owner).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/Grace/.test(firstOwner) && left === 2 && /Step 4 of 4/.test(await p.locator('.steps').innerText())`, where `const owners = p.locator('.pick').filter({ has: p.locator('.field-label', { hasText: /^Owner$/ }) })`; `const firstOwner = (await owners.nth(1).innerText()).trim()`; `const left = (await owners.allInnerTexts()).filter((t) => /No owner yet/.test(t)).length`. Else it says: a goal’s owner started as “{firstOwner}”, {left} left with no owner, progress “{p.locator('.steps').innerText()}”.
- **Step.** Press the “Create Field Operations” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/ready”.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) it is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `` JSON.stringify(rows) === JSON.stringify(['first-check-in', 'assign', 'invite']) && said.includes(`Give ${left === 1 ? '1 goal' : `${left} goals`} an owner.`) && !/Add your people/.test(await p.locator('main').innerText()) ``, where `const owners = p.locator('.pick').filter({ has: p.locator('.field-label', { hasText: /^Owner$/ }) })`; `const left = (await owners.allInnerTexts()).filter((t) => /No owner yet/.test(t)).length`; `const block = p.getByRole('region', { name: 'Getting started' }).or(p.locator('section.getting-started'))`; `const rows = await block.first().locator('.gs-row').evaluateAll((rs) => rs.map((r) => r.getAttribute('data-row')))`; `const said = await block.first().innerText()`. Else it says: Home’s Getting started: {rows.join(', ')} · “{said.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 200)}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Ben, on his first visit: who set it up and what's his.
- Switch to Ben in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/set up Field Operations on \d+ \w+ and gave you 1 goal\./.test(ben) && /Post your first check-in/.test(ben)`, where `const block = p.getByRole('region', { name: 'Getting started' }).or(p.locator('section.getting-started'))`; `const ben = await block.first().innerText()`. Else it says: Ben’s Getting started: “{ben.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 200)}”.
- **Step.** Press the “Hide this” button.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** The page’s heading area shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the getting started (`section.getting-started`) is not there (else: Hide this does not keep the block away).
- **Check:** (`logged`) scored as met here.
